page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g8i.3xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 12 dedicated vCPUs utilizing the x86_64 architecture, specifically running on Intel Xeon 8475B processors clocked at 2.7 GHz. The instance is equipped with 48.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per virtual core.

This instance configuration does not include local storage or bundled GPUs, meaning all storage requirements must be met via external network-attached block storage. For network connectivity, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 10 Gbps. It does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The ecs.g8i.3xlarge offers a balanced resource profile suitable for general-purpose workloads that require dedicated CPU resources without the need for specialized hardware acceleration or local high-speed storage. This resource density makes it a qualitatively cost-efficient option for standard enterprise applications, web serving, middle-tier application servers, and moderate database workloads.
